page: Microsoft Azure D8nds_v6 is a general-purpose virtual machine belonging to the Dndv6 family, powered by Intel x86_64 processors and managed via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance is configured with 8 dedicated vCPUs and 32.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio with 4.0 GB of RAM allocated per core. It operates without dedicated GPU hardware acceleration.

A key component of this virtual machine configuration is the inclusion of 472 GB of high-speed local NVMe SSD storage alongside support for Premium Storage. The hardware architecture incorporates network optimization features designed to handle demanding throughput requirements without needing external block storage for scratch space or ephemeral caches.

Cost efficiency for this profile stems from its balanced allocation of compute, memory, and fast onboard solid-state storage. By bundling 472 GB of direct-attached NVMe storage, workloads benefit from reduced dependency on remote disk provisioning for high-churn operations. However, deployments requiring hardware-accelerated computation or persistent local storage must account for the lack of GPUs and the ephemeral nature of standard local disks.

Given its hardware distribution, the D8nds_v6 is suited for general application hosting, relational and in-memory database caching, continuous integration and deployment agents, web application tiers, and data ingestion pipelines requiring fast local temporary storage.
description: Microsoft Azure D8nds_v6 is a general-purpose, network-optimized virtual machine powered by an x86_64 Intel processor. Built on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor, the instance provides 8 dedicated vCPUs alongside 32.0 GB of RAM, preserving a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio with 4.0 GB per core. The server includes 472 GB of local NVMe SSD storage for low-latency scratch operations and offers Premium Storage compatibility, though it features no hardware GPU accelerators. With its dedicated compute allocation, bundled high-speed ephemeral disk, and network-optimized profile, the D8nds_v6 offers strong resource density for input-output sensitive computing tasks. It is well suited for production application backends, relational databases, continuous integration build nodes, caching tiers, and general-purpose enterprise workloads.
